sentences.en: I used to own an excavation business, and run backhoes.
sentences.zh: 我过去经营一家挖掘公司，并操作过挖土机。

sentences.en: Lord Carnarvon financed the excavation of Tutankhamun's tomb.
sentences.zh: 卡纳封勋爵资助了图坦卡蒙陵墓的发掘。

sentences.en: During excavation work, the tiled floor of a Roman villa was found.
sentences.zh: 在挖掘工作中，发现了一座罗马别墅的瓷砖地板。

senses.zh: 挖掘;开凿 - 开凿的洞穴(或山路等) - (发掘出来的)古迹;出土的文物
